description: Drivaron, the ride-hail driver's advisor for earning more. Reference hourly targets, average speeds and starting minimum per km per city for ride-hail drivers (Uber, inDrive, DiDi, Cabify, Yango) in Spanish-speaking Latin America, with the apps that operate there. Use it for typical numbers before grading an offer or estimating income.

country.description: Country name, ISO code (CO, MX, GT...) or currency. Empty for all.

lang.description: Language of the summary: es (default) or en.

name: get_market_defaults

app.description: The Drivaron app and its Play download link.

color.description: green, yellow or red for offers.

result.description: All numbers, raw and formatted in local currency.

summary.description: One-paragraph answer in the requested language, ready to show the driver.
